title: The help box promises an answer at once, but often the member gets only a thank-you and no word on when a person will answer
what: Both help boxes open with 'Ask a question and get an answer at once'. The quick answer only comes when the AI key is set, the monthly AI budget is not used up and the AI call works. Otherwise the member sees only 'Thanks! We read every message.' The box itself never says the MettleUp team will answer later or where that answer will show.
expected: Promise only what always happens (for example 'Ask a question. Most get an answer in seconds; if not, the MettleUp team replies here'), and when no quick answer comes, say the team will reply and where to find it.
how_often: every question asked when the AI answer is off, used up or fails
fix_line: Soften the opening line and add a 'the team will reply here' line when no quick answer comes

title: The same action is called 'bring back' on one button and 'restore' on the next
what: The Google Drive card says 'Bring back a Google Drive backup', asks 'Bring back your Drive backup?' and confirms with 'Bring it back'. The very next buttons on the same card say 'Undo the restore?', 'Undo restore' and 'Undo the last restore', and the backup file row says 'Restore from a backup'. A member has to guess that bring back and restore are one thing.
expected: One word for one action across the backup page, for example 'restore' everywhere or 'bring back' everywhere.
how_often: every time they use the backup page
fix_line: Pick one word for restoring and use it on every backup button and question

title: With bigger text on a small phone, the title of the 'delete your account' question is cut off
what: Every 'Are you sure?' question shows its title in a sheet that allows at most two lines and then cuts it with dots. The title sits beside a 48-wide close button and grows up to 1.6 times with the phone's text size. 'Erase this phone and delete your account?' needs three lines at 320 to 360 wide once text is a little larger, so the member reads 'Erase this phone and delete your…' on the one question that deletes their account.
expected: Titles of questions wrap fully (no line limit), or the longest ones are shortened so they always fit.
who: members with larger text on small phones
how_often: every time they erase with account delete
fix_line: Let the sheet title wrap without a line limit

title: The old ForgeAI logo is still one of the app's shared pieces
what: The shared pieces still hold the old 'FORGE AI' wordmark, which tells screen readers 'ForgeAI'. No screen uses it today, but it sits next to the pieces every new screen is built from, so the old brand can come back by mistake.
expected: Only the MettleUp mark in the shared pieces; the old wordmark removed.
who: members, if a screen uses it again

Our voice server keeps only a call count, not the clip; whether the outside speech service keeps it cannot be read in code.
